title: 稀疏化：GBLM 梯度融合显著性逐行剪枝
title_en: Sparsity: GBLM Gradient-Fused Saliency Rowwise Pruning
description: GBLM-Pruner 在 Wanda 的 |W|·RMS(激活) 显著性上再融合一项梯度证据：|W|·√(Σ_s (g_s·scale)²)，两项相加（或取梯度倒数）后逐行选最小的 int(in·sparsity) 个置零。任何一处聚合方式、缩放因子或排序稳定性想当然，得到的掩码都不同。
description_en: GBLM-Pruner fuses a gradient term on top of Wanda's |W|·RMS(activation) saliency: |W|·√(Σ_s (g_s·scale)²). The two terms are added (or the gradient is inverted) before picking the int(in·sparsity) smallest entries per row. Any shortcut in aggregation, scaling, or sort stability yields a different mask.
